scope: Reuse positive regular first-index paths from a canonical-root walk during full extraction; preserve source reading, precedence, host path identity, filesystem fallback and finite retention. Local macOS arm64.
changes: Admit and retain a single path/record for each selected regular index.ts in a separate positive hint set, built without holding the shared resolution-cache lock.
Probe hints only after exact/extension file candidates. Unknown, ignored, differently spelled, later-index and file-link targets retain filesystem lookup; no absence is inferred.
Reset hints at each extraction and omit them entirely in workspace-only mode. Preserve canonical source reads and pre-open/opened-handle validation.
Reject the measured source-I/O shortcut and static-dispatch variant after fan-in regressed about 16%; src/input.rs is byte-identical to the baseline.

tests.bounded_hint_quota: 1.5 times the sum of source-path bytes; full mode must reject retained hints, workspace-only mode succeeds.
tests.scope_limit: New filesystem and quota fixtures are native tests; Miri retains its named pure-code selection.

uv run --python 3.13 --no-project python -B scripts/mutation.py --file src/imports.rs --output target/tooling/mutation-source-walk-hints

"""Run sequential normal-binary comparisons after checks and builds have exited."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys

area=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert 'HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH' not in os.environ
for workload in ['fan-in','call-heavy','monorepo','directory-index']:
    command=[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/benchmark.py','--binary',str(area/'after-jscycles'),'--baseline',str(area/'before-jscycles'),'--workload',workload,'--files','10000','--samples','21','--output',str(area/f'{workload}-comparison.json')]
    if workload=='monorepo': command += ['--packages','64','--aliases','4096']
    print('Running',command,flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command,check=True,timeout=180)

"""Verify first-index hint hits and a real uncached later-index fallback."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

area=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out=area/'hotpath';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for workload in ['fan-in','call-heavy','monorepo','directory-index']:
    for suffix in ['', '-benchmark']:
        path=Path('target/tooling/hotpath')/f'{workload}{suffix}.json'
        json.loads(path.read_text());shutil.copy2(path,out/path.name)
large=out/'directory-index-large.json';large.unlink(missing_ok=True)
command=[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/benchmark.py','--workload','directory-index','--files','10000','--samples','3','--output',str(out/'directory-index-large-benchmark.json')]
subprocess.run(command,env=dict(os.environ,HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH=str(large)),check=True,timeout=180)

def calls(path,name):
    profile=json.loads(path.read_text())
    return sum(row['calls'] for row in profile['functions_timing']['data'] if row['name'].endswith('::'+name))

for workload,expected in [('directory-index',1000),('directory-index-large',10000)]:
    path=out/f'{workload}.json'
    assert calls(path,'retain_index_hint')==expected
    assert calls(path,'try_resolve_index')==0
    print(workload,expected,'positive hints; zero uncached directory-index calls',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jscycles-index-fallback-profile-') as temporary:
    root=Path(temporary)
    (root/'package.json').write_text('{"name":"fallback"}')
    (root/'jscycles.yaml').write_text('{}')
    (root/'entry.ts').write_text("import './folder';")
    (root/'folder').mkdir()
    (root/'folder/index.tsx').write_text("import '../entry';")
    path=out/'later-index-fallback.json';path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    result=subprocess.run([str(Path('target/release/jscycles').resolve()),str(root),'--inner','--no-tsconfig','--json','--config',str(root/'jscycles.yaml')],env=dict(os.environ,HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH=str(path)),capture_output=True,timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode==1 and not result.stderr,result.stderr
    assert json.loads(result.stdout)['has_file_cycles'] is True
    assert calls(path,'retain_index_hint')==0 and calls(path,'try_resolve_index')==1
    print('Verified one uncached later-index lookup and the expected cycle',flush=True)
shutil.copy2('target/release/jscycles',area/'profile-jscycles')

performance.method: 21 alternating samples plus one warm-up per saved normal binary on the same corpus. Checks, builds, mutation and Miri jobs finish before timing. JSON outputs agree byte for byte. Instrumented profiling follows timing in a separate build; normal release binary restored afterward.
performance.limits: Warm synthetic local evidence; no customer latency budget, cold-cache, cross-platform, statistical significance, madge comparison or universal speedup. Current hint and fallback call counts are observed in Hotpath; previous per-directory filesystem resolution is inferred from the old loop.

unchanged.note: Source reading, manifests, locks, check commands, public doctest, workspace/tsconfig and parser/FFI code unchanged. Prior sanitizer campaigns keep their source scope.

limitations: Supported hosted targets and Linux-only filesystem cases were not executed locally.
No full Rust-OE certification, hostile-filesystem confinement, live reload, commit, push or publication.
